message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most prominent U.S. airports—those that handle huge passenger volumes, serve as key hubs for airlines, or have significant cargo operations:

| Airport (IATA) | City / State | Notable Features |
|-----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International** (ATL) | Atlanta, GA | Largest hub worldwide; busiest airport by passengers & flights. |
| **Los Angeles International** (LAX) | Los Angeles, CA | Major gateway to Asia/Pacific; high international traffic. |
| **Chicago O’Hare International** (ORD) | Chicago, IL | One of the world’s oldest major hubs; heavy domestic/International mix. |
| **Dallas/Fort Worth International** (DFW) | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | Large connecting hub; strong cargo network. |
| **Denver International** (DEN) | Denver, CO | Highest elevation commercial airport; growing hub status. |
| **John F. Kennedy International** (JFK) | New York, NY | Primary East Coast gateway to Europe/Africa. |
| **San Francisco International** (SFO) | San Francisco, CA | Key West‑East Asian corridor; tech‑industry focus. |
| **Seattle/Tacoma International** (SEA) | Seattle, WA | Hub for Alaska Airlines & Delta; important Pacific trade route. |
| **Miami International** (MIA) | Miami, FL | Main Caribbean/Latin American connector. |
| **Orlando International** (ORF) | Orlando, FL | Heavy leisure travel; top tourist destination. |
| **Phoenix Sky Harbor International** (PHX) | Phoenix, AZ | Growing Southwest hub; desert region access. |
| **George Bush Intercontinental** (IAH) | Houston, TX | Strong airline hub + massive cargo center. |
| **Philadelphia International** (PHL) | Philadelphia, PA | Important Northeast hub; close proximity to NYC. |
| **Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County** (DTW) | Detroit, MI | Historically major hub; now focuses on low-cost carriers. |

These airports dominate air traffic both domestically and internationally, serving millions of travelers each year while also acting as critical nodes for freight and logistics across North America.
message.reasoning:
The user asks "Tell me some of the major airports in the United States." They want information about major US airports. We can provide a list with details like location and IATA codes.

We don't need to call any tool; it's just general knowledge. So we respond directly.
